tool_input.command:
python3 -c "
import json,hashlib
r=json.load(open('eval-log/system-spec-completeness-report.json'))
snap=r['artifact_snapshot']['artifacts']
bad=[p for p,d in snap.items() if hashlib.sha256(open(p,'rb').read()).hexdigest()!=d]
print('snapshot entries',len(snap),'mismatch',bad)
print('aspects',[(a.get('aspect') or a.get('id'), a.get('verdict')) for a in r['aspects']] if isinstance(r['aspects'],list) else r['aspects'])
print('findings severities',[f.get('severity') for f in r['findings']], 'gaps',r['gaps'])
b=json.load(open('eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec/R3-import/import-payload.json'))
for a,path in zip(b['artifacts'],['specs/billing-audit-system-spec.md','architecture/billing-audit-system-architecture.md']):
  t=open(path,encoding='utf-8').read()
  miss=[k for k,v in a['sections'].items() if v.strip() not in t]
  for st,secs in (a.get('subtype_sections') or {}).items():
    miss+= [st+':'+k for k,v in secs.items() if v.strip() not in t]
  print(path,'sections not verbatim in body:',miss)
"
